statement: For every 99-by-99 symmetric binary zero-diagonal matrix A with exactly 14 ones in every integer row, put r_uv=(A^2)_uv+A_uv-2 for u<v and let F3 count unordered residuals not divisible by 3. Then F3 belongs to {0,4} union {6,7,...,4851}. If F3=4, the four nonzero residue pairs form a simple four-cycle on four vertices whose residues alternate 1,2,1,2 in cyclic order. These are necessary conditions only; no adjacency realization of four defects or any other allowed value is asserted.
